title: sedum glabrum
intro: Sedum glabrum, commonly known as the yellow stonecrop, is a type of succulent plant belonging to the Crassulaceae family. This plant is known for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing due to its antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Sedum glabrum include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever, diarrhea, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Sedum glabrum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
